subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris on June 15th. Your flight details are as follows: - Departure: June 15th, 9:00 AM - Arrival: June 15th, 3:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
